messages:
harry: Quick idea  summer picnic + little raffle at Dolores Park next Thu 6/24 ~1pm? Short window so folks can head back to afternoon meetings. Bring a snack or just come hang. React with emoji: :sun_with_face: = picnic, :gift: = want to bring a raffle prize, :pizza: = want pizza order.
mina: :sun_with_face: Love this. I can bring lemon bars. :lemon:
jo: In if there's pizza. :pizza: Also can bring a frisbee.
soph: I can do a small raffle prize (Redwood mug + stickers). :gift:
luke: Hybrid-friendly? I might be remote that day but can pop in later. Zoom link?
harry: I'll post a Zoom link for remote folks. Provisional plan: courtyard spot at 1pm, quick raffle at 1:45. If rain fallback to Annex.
mina: Allergy check  nuts in lemon bars? I can make nut-free.
jo: Thanks, please label allergens. I'm peanut-allergic so appreciate that.
soph: Noted  I'll label my prize with a note.
event-bot: Event draft created: "Sunset Picnic & Raffle"  Thu Jun 24  1:00 PM  Dolores Park  RSVP link: https://calendar.example.com/event/picnic177 (reminder 6 hours prior)
luke: I'll RSVP remote for now. If weather's nice I might swing by after 2pm.
harry: Great  if you want to bring a thing, react :gift: for prize, :pizza: for pizza, otherwise react :sun_with_face:. I'll finalize by Tue 6/22 5pm.
mina: :gift: (also bringing nut-free bars)
jo: :pizza:
soph: :gift:
event-bot: Reminder set: confirmation message to thread on Tue Jun 22 17:00.
harry: Thanks all  will confirm final food counts Tue and post Zoom. Casual and short  bring sunscreen. :sunglasses:
